description: Twenty-one additive context variants that double the effective spatial matrix from 210 to 420 while adding real-world and game-line applicability hooks.

unified.label: Unified All Systems
unified.focus: Treat the place as overlapping territory whose meaning changes depending on which supernatural population is observing it.
questions: Which sphere sees the place first?
Which interpretation is wrong but politically useful?
What mundane function prevents any faction from simply taking it?

vampire.label: Vampire: The Masquerade
vampire.focus: Prioritize feeding access, secrecy, mortal institutions, status, domain boundaries, retainers, and violations of the Masquerade.
questions: Who claims feeding rights?
Which mortal routine protects the Masquerade?
What debt or prestation is attached to access?

werewolf.label: Werewolf: The Apocalypse
werewolf.focus: Prioritize spiritual ecology, Weaver structure, Wyrm contamination, Wyld persistence, territory, packs, and routes through the Umbra.
questions: What spirit reflects the real-world use?
What has the built environment done to the local Gauntlet?
Which pack or sept considers intervention necessary?

breeds.label: Werewolf Changing Breeds
breeds.focus: Prioritize species-specific territory, ecological niches, hidden kin networks, migration routes, and conflicts between Fera duties.
questions: Which Changing Breed reads this place differently from Garou?
What mortal land use helps one species and harms another?
Which old compact applies here?

hunter.label: Hunter: The Reckoning
hunter.focus: Prioritize evidence, surveillance, human vulnerability, practical access, institutional response, and the danger of drawing the wrong conclusion.
questions: What can ordinary people actually prove?
Which observation method creates risk?
What human cost follows a mistaken purge?

changeling.label: Changeling
changeling.focus: Prioritize emotional use, dreams, memory, performance, childhood, community imagination, Banality, thresholds, and the Dreaming reflection of the site.
questions: What recurring human story feeds the place?
Where does Banality concentrate?
What forgotten promise changes the Dreaming reflection?

mage.label: Mage: The Awakening
mage.focus: Prioritize Mysteries, resonance, symbols, infrastructure, institutional knowledge, occult correspondences, and competing interpretations of the same anomaly.
questions: What real-world system acts as the Mystery's carrier?
Which Arcanum reveals a different layer?
Who benefits from the accepted explanation?

contextVariants.title: Public Access Pattern
contextVariants.effect: Unusual movement follows the location's actual public-access rules, queues, entrances, restricted rooms, and accessibility arrangements.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Build the scene around who can enter, when they can enter, and which legitimate rule blocks the characters.

contextVariants.title: Scheduled Service Cycle
contextVariants.effect: Activity changes according to timetables, shift rotations, appointments, school hours, transit schedules, or programmed public services.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The correct time window matters more than supernatural force.

contextVariants.title: Weather and Exposure
contextVariants.effect: Weather, tide, snow, heat, smoke, darkness, or seasonal daylight changes the location's ordinary operation and physical accessibility.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Use current exposure and terrain as a practical clock or access problem.

contextVariants.title: Insurance and Liability Response
contextVariants.effect: Barriers, cameras, warning signs, incident reports, and restricted areas exist because the operator fears lawsuits, theft, or regulatory penalties.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: An ordinary incident-reporting system becomes the central obstacle or source of evidence.

contextVariants.title: Digital Reputation Distortion
contextVariants.effect: Conflicting descriptions arise from reviews, social media, old listings, delivery applications, and automated map data rather than supernatural concealment.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The characters must compare online claims with the actual physical place.

contextVariants.title: Neighborhood Displacement Pressure
contextVariants.effect: The location's changing clientele and security reflect rent increases, redevelopment, tourism pressure, or displacement of long-term residents.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A real-estate decision changes who can safely use the place.

contextVariants.title: Supply-Chain Substitution
contextVariants.effect: Changed materials, missing products, locked storage, or unfamiliar contractors come from shortages and supplier substitutions.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: One substituted material creates a mundane failure with misleading occult symbolism.

contextVariants.title: Accessibility Workaround
contextVariants.effect: Side entrances, improvised ramps, service elevators, escorts, and unusual staff procedures compensate for inaccessible design.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: A route that looks secret exists to make the place usable to ordinary people.

contextVariants.title: Event and Permit Friction
contextVariants.effect: Temporary fencing, unusual hours, crowd control, or official presence comes from an event permit, ceremony, protest, market, or public gathering.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Public attendance and permit conditions create a visible deadline.

contextVariants.title: Ownership Transition
contextVariants.effect: Keys, records, staff authority, and access rules are confused because the property recently changed owners, operators, tenants, or management companies.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Two legitimate authorities issue incompatible instructions.

contextVariants.title: Infrastructure Outage
contextVariants.effect: Dark areas, offline cameras, strange sounds, and emergency access result from a power, water, communications, ventilation, or transit failure.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The outage creates an ordinary hazard and a temporary blind spot.

contextVariants.title: Tourism and Seasonal Use
contextVariants.effect: Crowds, closures, temporary workers, and altered prices follow tourism seasons, school calendars, festivals, or migration of visitors.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The location changes character depending on who is in town this week.

contextVariants.title: Predator Route Overlap
contextVariants.effect: The place lies along a movement, feeding, pursuit, or escape route used by supernatural predators without being controlled by them.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Real-world opening hours and exits determine when the route is usable.

contextVariants.title: Spirit Echo Catchment
contextVariants.effect: The site's real-world ecology or repeated human use attracts echoes from a nearby spirit territory without forming a stable locus of its own.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The echo intensifies when the ordinary environmental condition is disturbed.

contextVariants.title: Resonance Leakage
contextVariants.effect: Knowledge, machinery, ritual repetition, or emotional intensity elsewhere leaks into the location through an ordinary network or shared infrastructure.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Tracing the real-world connection identifies the actual source of the Mystery.

contextVariants.title: Dreaming Threshold
contextVariants.effect: The site's ordinary stories, performances, childhood memories, celebrations, or abandoned expectations briefly align with a nearby path through the Dreaming.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The threshold exists only while a particular human activity is occurring.

contextVariants.title: Surveillance Shadow
contextVariants.effect: Cameras, access logs, transit records, public reports, or private security capture fragments of supernatural movement without understanding it.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The evidence is useful only when aligned with the site's real operating procedures.

contextVariants.title: Inherited Name Confusion
contextVariants.effect: Supernatural records refer to an older building, former tenant, renamed road, moved institution, or demolished landmark sharing the present location's name.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Historical maps and property records separate the current place from the actual target.

contextVariants.title: Line-Specific Safehouse
contextVariants.effect: A small supernatural group exploits the location's genuine access patterns, staff routines, physical layout, or institutional authority as an unofficial refuge or operating point.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: The cover works only because the users understand the real-world function better than outsiders do.

contextVariants.title: Unstable Locus or Mystery
contextVariants.effect: The interaction between the site's actual ecology, infrastructure, memory, or repeated use produces an active effect that no authority has successfully classified.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Changing the mundane operation changes the supernatural effect in a repeatable but dangerous way.

contextVariants.title: Multi-Faction Jurisdiction
contextVariants.effect: The location is formally recognized because its real-world function serves several supernatural systems at once, forcing overlapping claims, inspections, or negotiated access.
contextVariants.mechanicalSeed: Each sphere's official record describes the same place differently, and all are partially correct.
